landing.heroTitle: FluxTrace — from reduction through tracing to identifying malware behaviour in logs produced by Contradef.
landing.heroLead: Pipeline of <hl>heuristic reduction and regex</hl>, <hl>flow through the pivot</hl> (<hl>consolidated interpretation</hl>), <hl>MITRE ATT&CK</hl>, <hl>VirusTotal</hl> and <hl>Mermaid diagrams</hl>. Monitor batches with RBAC by role.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Ideal for teams that need to process large log volumes with traceability and a clear analysis workflow.
landing.f_reduce_desc: Batch uploads, deduplication and reduction aligned with operational context.
landing.f_interp_desc: Per-batch view: events, timelines and browsing of extracted data.
landing.f_focus_desc: Filters by function, terms and regexes to narrow the investigation.
landing.f_artifacts_desc: Access generated files and compare with originals when stored on the server.
landing.f_acl_desc: User and admin roles with reset password policies.
landing.f_admin_desc: Account management, default password with mandatory change.
landing.archDesc: Batches with traceable states, analysis queue and artifact storage — ideal for repeatable analysis cycles and audit.
landing.sec_5: Force password change after admin reset
landing.stackFooter: React · Vite · tRPC · Express · PostgreSQL · Drizzle · Recharts
